I’m hiring a Director of GTM Operations to reimagine how our go-to-market operates as that shift happens, and to expand Zapier on Zapier, so our own teams showcase what AI orchestration can do at scale. You’ll build a lot of the systems yourself, direct bigger builds through your team and our engineering partners, and own what you ship after launch. You’ll report to the Senior Director, Technical Operations and Automation Platform, and work directly with our CRO, Sales and Marketing leaders, Finance and our COO. Our Sales and Marketing leaders set the targets and the strategy, and Finance owns comp and commissions. You show leaders what’s working, tell them when the numbers point somewhere else, and bring them proposals for what should change, with the trade-offs laid out. jobs.title: Engineering Lead, Clinical Operations
jobs.description: At Clover, the Business Enablement team leads our technological advancement while ensuring robust security and compliance. We deliver user-friendly corporate applications, manage complex data ecosystems, and provide efficient tech solutions across the organization. Our goal is simple: we make it easy for the business to do what’s right for Clover. We’re hiring a Engineering Lead to build the systems that help our clinical teams deliver services in the field and in members’ homes. You will own technical direction and delivery for scheduling, dispatch, field and mobile workflows, and the software that connects equipment and home technology to the operation. A likely first assignment is an “Air Traffic Control” system for field operations. A supervisor needs to understand what is happening and act when the plan breaks: a flat tire, a delayed visit, a missing piece of equipment, or a member whose availability changes. You will work with the people doing the job to decide what they need to see, what the system can help resolve, and when a human should intervene. This is a hands-on role that spans product and engineering. You will understand the business problem, shape the solution, build useful increments, and see whether they work. You may start without direct reports and can expect to coach and eventually manage one or two engineers. You should enjoy building personally and helping others become more capable. We value a tinkering instinct: try the unfamiliar tool, inspect the data, trace the failure, put a small improvement in front of a user, and learn from what happens. Hardware or connected-device experience can be a strong signal of that mindset, but it is not required. The central work is building dependable software for an operation that changes throughout the day. jobs.description: We were tired of hearing that healthcare is broken, so we decided to do something about it. At Nomi Health , we believe the care itself isn’t broken — it’s the business of healthcare that gets in the way. We’re rebuilding the system so it works the way it should: clear prices you can trust, faster payments that keep providers focused on patients, and data that helps employers make better decisions. Our work has already touched more than 30 million lives — from local communities in Michigan to some of the largest companies in the country. What You'll Do: Market solution design. jobs.title: Senior Security Operations Engineer
jobs.description: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. About the role: As a member of our Security Operations Team, you will collaborate with a global team of engineers to monitor and respond to security events, lead security incidents as Incident Commander, and lead digital forensic investigations in support of Employee Relations, Legal, Compliance, or Information Security cases. Although you will be focused on security incident response, you will also have the opportunity to create and maintain runbooks, and automated workflows, and assist in process refinement and implementation.
